name: Proving Grounds
summary: Proving Grounds is an initiation rite given by Lieutenant Haggerdin to Alliance recruits enlisting with the Stormpike Guard in Alterac. To earn an official Stormpike Insignia, aspirants must venture into the harpy-infested Icewing Caverns and recover a planted battle standard. Proving one's courage in the cavern marks the first step toward rising through the expedition's military ranks.

sections.title: A Measure of Courage
sections.body: The Stormpike Guard wages a relentless campaign in Alterac Valley against the Frostwolf Clan. Lieutenant Haggerdin, coordinating forces from the Alliance encampment in the Alterac Mountains, refuses to send green recruits onto the battlefield without a test. Before granting any soldier an official place in the guard, Haggerdin demands proof of skill and nerve by sending them into the treacherous Icewing Caverns southwest of Dun Baldar.

sections.title: The Icewing Caverns
sections.body: The trial is straightforward in concept but deadly in execution: a Stormpike banner stands planted deep within the subterranean ice tunnels. The caverns are not empty; vicious frost harpies nest in the frostbitten recesses and eagerly tear apart unwary trespassers. Returning with the banner intact demonstrates that a recruit can navigate dangerous terrain, withstand brutal predators, and maintain discipline under pressure.

sections.title: The Stormpike Insignia
sections.body: Surviving the cavern and returning the standard earns a soldier the Stormpike initiate's insignia, welcoming them officially into the expeditionary force. As Haggerdin promises, the insignia is not merely a trinket—it is a mark of rank that can be enhanced as a soldier earns greater honor on the battlefield, aspiring toward legendary honors such as the Eye of Command.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Haggerdin is an Alliance officer stationed in the Alterac Mountains who oversees recruitment and field recognition for the Stormpike Guard. He tests prospective fighters and rewards their service with military insignias.
The Icewing Caverns lie southwest of the Alliance stronghold of Dun Baldar inside the frozen reaches of Alterac Valley. They are labyrinthine subterranean tunnels carved out of ice and stone.

faq.q: What threats dwell inside the Icewing Caverns?
faq.answer: The caverns are inhabited by ferocious ice harpies. Lieutenant Haggerdin warns recruits that these savage creatures will not hesitate to ambush trespassers and tear out their throats.

faq.q: Why does the Stormpike Guard require this test?
faq.answer: The battle against the Frostwolf orcs is brutal and unforgiving. Haggerdin insists on weeding out untested recruits before they join the main lines, ensuring every soldier bearing their banner can fight under harsh conditions.

faq.q: What is the reward for completing the proving ground?
faq.answer: Completing the trial rewards the recruit with a Stormpike initiate's insignia. Haggerdin upgrades this insignia to more powerful versions as the soldier accumulates honor in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Who are the Frostwolves mentioned by Haggerdin?
faq.answer: The Frostwolf Clan is an orcish clan that has inhabited Alterac Valley since their exile decades ago. The Stormpike Guard considers them hostile savages standing in the way of Alliance interests and excavation in the valley.

angles.text: The Stormpike expedition represents the Alliance's primary military endeavor in Alterac, blending dwarven archaeological ambitions with territorial defense against the Horde.
The Stormpike Guard is predominantly led by Ironforge dwarves seeking ancestral relics and titan mysteries, making this trial an entry into one of your race's proudest military units.
